plugin.name: Mafia III: Definitive Edition Fusion Fix
BorderlessWindowed.description: When FULLSCREEN is off in the game's display options, the game runs in a borderless window covering its monitor at the desktop resolution. Off shows the game's framed window. Applies at once.
SkipIntro.description: Starts straight at the main menu, without the middleware and studio logos and the save warning screen. Off shows them as in the original game. Needs a restart.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Choose the language used for the fix’s settings text. Auto follows the game or editor language.
